qualityShelfPolicy: The learner-facing Short Stories shelf is capped at 50 curated works. Selection stays balanced across the six story categories and favors the longer available public-domain excerpts. The 100-record Aozora source archive remains intact for Saved/Continue compatibility and future longer-excerpt replacements.
longFormDirection: Future story work should deepen the 50 visible selections with longer legally reusable excerpts and richer learning support rather than increasing the learner-facing count above 50.
sourceYearPolicy: Use 2026/current fiction first when it is legally reusable for redistribution. If unavailable, use 2025, then 2024, then the newest verified legally reusable source available. Public-domain Aozora works display their actual first-publication year when known, otherwise a source-edition year.

rights.policy: Only works identified as copyright-expired/public-domain are used in this shelf.
rights.fullTextPolicy: Sakura bundles only public-domain excerpts selected for study and links to the full Aozora work/card.

qualityPolicy.storyText: 100 real Japanese works use verbatim public-domain source excerpts; no AI-written fiction is bundled.
qualityPolicy.difficulty: Sakura approximate study difficulty only; native works are not JLPT-graded.
qualityPolicy.orthography: Original Aozora transcription is preserved in excerpts.
qualityPolicy.currentness: Publication/edition year is shown honestly; old literature is never labeled as 2026 content.
qualityPolicy.selection: The visible v8 Quality Shelf uses 50 balanced selections and favors longer existing excerpts. Source records outside the shelf are retained rather than deleted.
